subject: Confirmed spend schedule, PO mapping, and net terms for Q2 commitment
messages:
From: DeltaWare Procurement <procurement@deltaware.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@deltaware.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood commitment -- PO format and invoicing cadence

Hi Sean,

We reviewed the commercial term sheet and our sourcing team is ready to issue the PO for the Q2 committed spend. A couple of procurement constraints we need to confirm before we can route to AP:

- PO numbering/line item expectations: our ERP needs each SKU line to map to an internal GL code. Can Redwood provide a recommended line-item breakdown for: Hosted API (usage), Dedicated (reserved GPU hrs), Optimize (credits)?
- Invoice cadence: we prefer quarterly invoices aligned to calendar quarters; however, AP can accept monthly invoices if the PO explicitly states "monthly invoices against quarterly commitment".
- Net terms: our standard is Net 60 for new vendors; is Net 45 an option under the committed pricing?
- Required artifacts: we attached the DeltaWare PO template. Please confirm if you need a completed W-9 or COI before PO acceptance.

Attached: DeltaWare_PO_Template.pdf

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Senior Sourcing Manager
DeltaWare

--
This request will route through my team and AP once we have the mappings and any contract amendment language for the invoice cadence.
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: DeltaWare Procurement <procurement@deltaware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood commitment -- PO format and invoicing cadence

Tom / Elaine,

Appreciate the clear checklist — good news, we can support what you need. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

- PO/line item mapping: we can provide a recommended breakdown. Typical mapping we send: 
  1) RW-API-UNIT — Hosted API per 1k tokens (apply committed pricing)
  2) RW-DEDI-HR — Dedicated reserved GPU hours (monthly committed qty)
  3) RW-OPT-CREDIT — Redwood Optimize credits (one-time allocation)

  I will attach a CSV with suggested GL-compatible line items after we confirm your GL codes.

- Invoice cadence: we can invoice quarterly to match the commitment. If you prefer monthly invoices with "against quarterly commitment" language, we can accept that and include explicit reference in the SOW amendment.

- Net terms: for the committed volume in DEAL-4492 we can extend Net 45. Net 60 would be acceptable only without the committed-discount; the discount is tied to the shorter term. 

- Artifacts: attaching our W-9 (Redwood_W-9.pdf). COI not required for this contract. Our billing contact is Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) for AP questions.

Next steps / asks from DeltaWare:
- Please send the PO back with your GL codes added to the line items (attached).
- Confirm whether you want quarterly consolidated invoices or monthly invoices billed against the quarterly commitment.
- If you want Net 45, we'll add one line in the contract amendment reflecting that term and the committed discount schedule.

Looping in Marissa for AR intake and Soojin for legal text on the amendment.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_W-9.pdf
From: DeltaWare Procurement <procurement@deltaware.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@deltaware.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@deltaware.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood commitment -- PO format and invoicing cadence

Sean,

Thanks — confirmed that Net 45 is acceptable. A couple clarifying items from AP: 

- We'll submit the PO with your suggested SKUs but need Redwood to confirm the exact text for the invoice reference field so our ERP matches payments to the commitment. Can you provide the short invoice reference string you expect?
- We will take monthly invoices (split invoice lane) but require a quarterly reconciliation invoice showing total committed vs. consumption. This reconciliation should be included as an attachment to the quarter-end invoice.
- AP also asked whether your invoices can include a single-line summary of discounts applied per invoice period (we cannot accept line-level discount adjustments in our ledger; summary is fine).

Attached: DeltaWare_PO_Template_filled.pdf (we filled names/addresses but left GL codes blank)

If you can confirm the invoice-reference string and acknowledge the monthly + quarter reconciliation flow, we'll sign and route the PO.

Regards,
Tom Reynolds
Senior Sourcing Manager
DeltaWare
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: DeltaWare Procurement <procurement@deltaware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood commitment -- PO format and invoicing cadence

Tom / Elaine,

Perfect — glad Net 45 works. Confirmations below and I've captured the required language for the PO and SOW amendment.

- Invoice reference string: "Redwood Deal 4492 — DeltaWare Commitment Q2". Please include that exact phrase in the PO invoice_reference field and on each invoice header.
- Invoicing flow: Redwood will issue monthly invoices (one per month) that reference the quarterly commitment. At quarter-end we will attach a reconciliation statement (CSV + PDF) that summarizes total committed amount, actual consumption, discounts applied (summary line), and any credit/shortfall. That reconciliation will be attached to the quarter-end invoice as requested.
- Discounts: we will include a single summary line on each invoice titled "Committed Discount (summary)" with the dollar amount for the period. Line-item rates will show the undiscounted unit price for transparency.

SOW amendment snippet (for your legal/AP copy):
"Redwood will provide committed pricing for DEAL-4492 subject to Net 45 payment terms. Redwood will submit monthly invoices and a quarterly reconciliation report. Payment shall be applied against the quarterly committed amount. Discounts will be summarized on invoice as a single line item."

Marissa: please confirm Redwood's AR email and provide the billing address we should include on the signed PO (copy below). Soojin: please advise if that SOW language looks ok for a short amendment.

Billing contact (to include on PO):
Marissa Cole
Accounts Receivable, Redwood Inference
ar@redwood.com
Redwood Inference, 410 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94103

Thanks all — happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to run through the reconciliation format.

Best,
Sean
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
